item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `make_images()` returning two `dspy.Image` values and passes it to `dspy.ReAct('question -> answer', tools=[make_images])`."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `DummyLM` with three scripted interactions: tool call, `finish`, then final extraction, and runs the agent once."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Inspects `lm.history[1]['messages'][1]['content']`, which is the second LM call's user message, not just the trajectory object."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Filters content parts by dicts with `type == 'image_url'` and asserts there are exactly two."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Also asserts the two `image_url.url` values equal the expected `a.png` and `b.png` URLs."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
